address: One&Only Royal Mirage, Arabian Court, Dubai Marina, Dubai
bio: Expect exciting and imaginative Indian cuisine that isn’t afraid to push the boundaries, but also a kitchen which knows quality ingredients and how to get the best out of them. The spacious restaurant relocated here to the luxury One&Only Royal Mirage hotel at the end of 2022. There are lots of large tables for bigger parties and even larger windows providing views over the gardens....
